visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a well-lit, modern living room. A black, hardshell medical equipment case sits open on a light wood adjustable side table. Inside the case, white electronic devices and various medical sensors are nested in custom-cut grey foam. In the background, a beige sofa, a large potted plant, and a wide-screen television are visible against a clean white wall. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom center. (2) The camera zooms in slightly, focusing on the interior of the case. The lid features a large instructional diagram showing a person wearing a headgear device. The foreground contains a transparent plastic bag holding tubes and a white electronic monitor. A pink plush toy is visible on the TV stand in the background, adding a touch of domesticity to the medical setting. (3) A person's arm and hand enter the frame from the bottom right, reaching into the case. The hand picks up a white rectangular device labeled with the Philips brand and a serial number. The camera follows the hand as it maneuvers the device, displaying attached wires and a grey finger-clip sensor. The person then points to a nasal cannula wrapped in plastic while continuing the demonstration.
